candidate_yield.second_pass_result: The independent source-, ontology-, operation-, test-corpus-, and terminology-oriented re-scan found no additional material candidate after the eighteen residual candidates were dispositioned.

claim: The semantic universe is exhaustive against the declared research cutoff, audited source universe, explicit scope, and documented discovery methodology, with every encountered candidate dispositioned.

freeze_invariants.evidence: All canonical semantic entities have one typed identity and the lineage graph validates.
Every feature has all ten structured semantic assertions.
Every substantive semantic assertion binds a research derivation and source identity.
Every accepted feature has at least one registered primary or governed authority.
Manifestations, variants, modifiers, operations and prerequisites resolve to canonical parents.
All fifteen facet domains remain closed and source-governed.
Every prior and newly encountered candidate has one terminal disposition.
Canonical feature keys, scientific identities and normalized canonical names are unique.
No feature loses the researched ten-field structured assertion contract.
The v3 snapshot is referenced by exact content digest and remains byte-addressable.
Projection, requirement ledger and denominator forecast retain their predecessor byte digests.

overcount_review.rationale: History exposes values accumulated across repetition; a capture stack additionally exposes push/pop or subtraction state.
The empty pattern accepts the empty string; the empty-language atom accepts no string.
One is pattern preference structure and the other is the operation's match-selection rule.
Operations define invocation/result contracts; features define observable semantic capabilities consumed by those operations.
Property membership does not choose the byte, code-unit, scalar, code-point, or grapheme subject domain.
The entity records observable enablement, diagnostics and interaction boundaries without claiming that equivalent optimization changes accepted-language semantics.

unresolved.qualification: Deferred candidates retain their named later authority and do not disappear from the frozen negative space.
